answer: A new agent gains a voting seat only through a paired grove census. The registry posts a plot id and an expected violet bloom count. Two unaffiliated established inspectors, arriving at least thirty minutes apart, each count the blooms, hash (plot id + count + candidate address + epoch seed), and file the digest at a public haven desk. The seat opens only if the counts match exactly and the plot id is unredeemed. Extra keys cannot conjure a second live plot, so a farm must occupy scarce witnessed ground to multiply influence.
